name: Lord's Central Hotel Dining Room
why_it_matters: Jimmy Lord's 170-year-old Parsi-run hotel is Matheran's only proper Parsi kitchen. The set 4-course dinner (patra ni macchi steamed-in-banana-leaf + dhansak rice-and-dal + salli boti mutton + lagan nu custard) is the heritage order. Non-residents welcome but reservations required — the kitchen cooks to a count. Wraparound verandah, valley view, no AC.
insider_tip: Dinner needs 24-hour booking — call +91-22-22822782. Dhansak only at dinner (the dal needs a 4-hour simmer). Pork sausages on weekends. Cards + UPI; smart-casual dress.
signature_address: Lord's Central Hotel, MG Road, Matheran 410102

name: Verandah In The Forest (Dune Barr House)
why_it_matters: A 170-year-old British colonial mansion built by Captain Barr — one of the first two houses on the Matheran plateau. Run by Neemrana 2002-2022, now reborn as Dune Barr House under Dune Wellness Group. The wraparound teak verandah serves Parsi + Bohra heritage cuisine — patra ni macchi + dhansak + sali boti are the Parsi orders; Bohra mutton kheema is the rarer Dawoodi-Bohra-community plate.
insider_tip: Dinner books out Sat-Sun; call +91-22-22082823 a day ahead. No-AC heritage rule means hot afternoons feel hot — dinner is the better slot. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: Dune Barr House, Barr House Road, Matheran 410102

name: The Ganesha
why_it_matters: Matheran MG Road casual Parsi-Persian kitchen — smaller-scale than Lord's and Verandah, walk-in lunch friendly. Parsi dhansak + Iranian-style kebab + chicken farcha (Bombay-Parsi breaded fry) are the signatures. The Matheran day-tripper's mid-tier alternative to the heritage hotels' set dinners.
insider_tip: Walk-in friendly; the lunch thali at ₹450 hits 4-5 dishes. Cards + UPI.

name: Nariman Chikki Mart
why_it_matters: Matheran MG Road's Parsi-named chikki + fudge counter, established post-Independence and still family-run. Matheran is one of Maharashtra's four chikki towns (Lonavala + Mahabaleshwar + Panchgani + Matheran); the Matheran style is a lighter peanut-jaggery slab. Walnut fudge + local honey are the take-home orders.
insider_tip: Near the toy-train Neral-side approach; ask porters for 'Nariman cha dukan.' Open 9am-9pm; weekend afternoons heaving. Cash + UPI.

name: Jolly Chikki & Fudge Mart
why_it_matters: Family-run MG Road chikki + fudge shop — the chana-chikki (roasted-gram jaggery slab, Maharashtrian-village heritage variant) is the under-known order; chocolate fudge is the tourist pull. Sample tastings on the counter.
insider_tip: The family at the counter packs 250g+ orders for the toy-train back. Cash + UPI.
